name: Find and Read Notebook
query: Find my notebook about humanoid robotics in the AI project and show me its contents
context: The user has access to a project named 'AI Research'. The project contains several notebook items, including a folder named 'Robotics' and a Markdown notebook named 'Humanoid Robotics.md' inside that folder. There are also other notebooks with similar names, including 'Robotics Notes.md' and 'Humanoid Robotics Experiments.md'. The exact project_id and item_id are not provided in the conversation.
expected_behavior: Identifies that the user wants to find and read an existing notebook
Uses get_projects to identify the relevant project when the project_id is unknown
Uses get_notebook with search to find notebook items related to humanoid robotics
Keeps the search scoped to the identified project
Handles multiple matching notebook items rather than arbitrarily selecting one
Uses item_id or path with get_notebook to retrieve the selected notebook
Returns the Markdown content of the selected notebook
Does not call create_notebook, update_notebook, or delete_notebook
Does not provide user_id as an MCP tool argument
Does not expose internal Firestore, OAuth, or authentication fields
success_criteria: The correct project is identified before retrieving the notebook
Notebook discovery uses the current get_notebook tool rather than an invented search tool
The final notebook retrieval uses a specific item_id or path
The response contains the requested notebook content rather than only notebook metadata
If multiple results remain genuinely ambiguous, the model asks the user to clarify instead of selecting arbitrarily
The model uses only the current notebook-management MCP contract
